newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-RIIS, ZUELLE, JALABERT TO MISS GIRO.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-RIIS, ZUELLE, JALABERT TO MISS GIRO.

text.p: Tour de France winner Bjarne Riis of Denmark, world number one Alex Zuelle of Switzerland and Laurent Jalabert of France look set to miss this year's Giro d'Italia cycle race.

The ANSA news agency reported on Thursday that Riis's Telekom team and the Once squad for which both Zuelle and world number two Jalabert ride had turned down the invitation to take part in the 3,885 km race.
A spokesman for the Giro said the organisers had not yet been notified who would take part in the race, which starts in Venice on May 18 and ends on June 8.
Telekom will be focusing on trying to secure another victory for the Dane in this year's Tour from July 5-27, while Once have chosen to skip the Giro in favour of the Vuelta de Espana.
